directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Wolf, I'd like you to take a look at this. Remember you told me about the burglars? I think it belonged to one of them. I found this notebook in the tunnel behind the railroad embankment.
entries.JA_current: Wolf, I'd like you to take a look at this. Remember you told me about the burglars? I think it belonged to one of them. I found this notebook in the tunnel behind the railroad embankment.
entries.JA_new: ウルフ、これを見てくれ。前に話してた盗人の件、覚えてるか？ その一人のものだと思う。線路の盛り土の裏にあるトンネルで見つけた。

entries.EN: Well, well, well... Yes, it's Fedka's notebook, I've seen it with him more than once. And his handwriting... So it turns out that he was the instigator after all? So that's how it is. Well, thank you, man, for finding out how it really went, I can see that you're an honest and fair man!
entries.JA_current: Well, well, well... Yes, it's Fedka's notebook, I've seen it with him more than once. And his handwriting... So it turns out that he was the instigator after all? So that's how it is. Well, thank you, man, for finding out how it really went, I can see that you're an honest and fair man!
entries.JA_new: なるほど……そうか、これはフェドカのノートだ。何度もあいつが持ってるのを見た。それに、この筆跡……やっぱり、仕掛けたのはあいつだったんだな？ そういうことか。真相を突き止めてくれてありがとう。お前は誠実で、公平な男だな！

entries.EN: No problem... But I have one more favor to ask of you: please take the Outcast back to the camp.
entries.JA_current: No problem... But I have one more favor to ask of you: please take the Outcast back to the camp.
entries.JA_new: どういたしまして……だが、もう一つ頼みがある。追放者をキャンプに戻してやってくれ。

entries.EN: All right, I will. Now it's clear that he's just an inexperienced loser, and not a thief. I'll have him taken care of, don't worry. Here, this is for you, personally, from me. One more thing: why don't you go over to the Trader, show him this information and let him know.
entries.JA_current: All right, I will. Now it's clear that he's just an inexperienced loser, and not a thief. I'll have him taken care of, don't worry. Here, this is for you, personally, from me. One more thing: why don't you go over to the Trader, show him this information and let him know.
entries.JA_new: 分かった、そうしよう。あいつはただの経験不足な間抜けで、盗人じゃないと分かったからな。こっちで面倒を見る。心配するな。ほら、これは俺からお前への礼だ。もう一つ頼みがある。商人のところへ行って、この情報を見せて伝えてくれ。

entries.EN: Okay, I'll go see him now.
entries.JA_current: Okay, I'll go see him now.
entries.JA_new: 分かった。今から会いに行く。
